name: OpenClaw HA Node — Assist Tools
description: Scoped OpenClaw tool wrappers (ha_call_service, ha_get_state, ...) that bridge HA Assist sessions to the paired openclaw-hass-node-app's command surface. Required for Assist; chat/cron/sub-agent sessions use the openclaw-hass-node-skill on top of nodes.invoke and don't need this plugin.

allowServices.description: Service-call patterns the plugin may invoke. Each item is a domain.service glob, e.g. 'light.*', 'switch.turn_*', 'homeassistant.update_entity'.

denyServices.description: Service-call patterns explicitly denied. Deny wins over allow.

allowReadEntities.description: Entity-id patterns ha_get_state / ha_list_states may return. Each item is an entity_id glob, e.g. 'light.*', 'sensor.living_room_*'.

denyReadEntities.description: Entity-id patterns explicitly hidden from reads. Deny wins.

allowAdminOps.description: Tier B admin gate. Must be true (with adminToken) to invoke reload_config / addon_start / addon_stop / addon_restart.

adminToken.description: Tier B admin token forwarded to the app's admin_token check. Required alongside allowAdminOps.
